literal: A harsh sceptre binds the unlearned; other than that, there is no burden to the earth.
translation: A tyrannical rule surrounds itself only with the ignorant; other than such a reign, there is no greater burden for the earth to bear.
modern: அறிவில்லாதவர்களைத் தன்பால் சேர்த்துக்கொள்ளும் கொடுங்கோல் ஆட்சி; அதைத் தவிர இந்த பூமிக்கு வேறு பெரிய சுமை எதுவும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet highlights the heavy burden of tyranny on the world. A cruel ruler with a harsh sceptre (கடுங்கோல்) naturally attracts and binds (பிணிக்கும்) only ignorant, unlearned people (கல்லார்) to his administration, as wise people avoid him. The poet asserts that there is no greater burden (பொறை) weighing down the earth (நிலக்கு) than this combination of a tyrant and his foolish counselors.
